facts.business: Minolta Finance Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in lending operations.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1) Reclassified loan account from Doubtful to Sub-Standard, reducing ECL provision by Rs 1.84 crore without actual recovery. 2) Interest expense not provided on few loan accounts (Rs 3.38 crore) and one specific borrower (Rs 2.43 crore) due to unavailable loan documents. 3) Quoted and unquoted investments of Rs 62.96 lakhs lack ownership documents. 4) Company did not obtain RBI approval for change in management in FY 2024-25.

key_risks: Rapid balance sheet growth leading to near-term losses
Asset quality monitoring and collections framework needs reinforcement
High cost of borrowings impacting profitability
Regulatory risk due to lack of RBI approval for change in management
Understatement of finance costs and impairment provisions as per auditor qualifications
